messages.content: I want telegram private message reply ai bot

Your **Telegram Private Message AI Auto-Reply Bot** is ready!

You can test and configure the bot directly via the live interactive preview:
👉 **[Open Live Web Dashboard & DM Simulator](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/a515bea3-ac5b-4e6a-b886-d94eec6dff67/13d4565b9f1ed6e36e335da4/)**

---

### 📦 What Has Been Built

1. **Interactive Telegram DM Simulator & Web Dashboard** ([index.html](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/index.html))
   - **Live 1-on-1 Chat Mockup**: Test incoming DMs in real time with typing indicators, response delays, and per-user memory tracking.
   - **Persona Studio**: Switch between *Executive Assistant*, *Freelancer / Consulting*, *Customer Support*, and *Out of Office*.
   - **Credentials Wizard**: Step-by-step guides for obtaining Telegram API keys and free Gemini API tokens.
   - **Config Generator**: Real-time `.env` file generator with 1-click copy & download.

2. **Personal Account Auto-Reply Script** ([userbot.py](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/userbot.py))
   - Built with **Telethon** (MTProto client) to run on your personal Telegram account.
   - Strictly replies only to **1-on-1 private messages (DMs)** — never posts in group chats or channels.
   - Automatic anti-loop filters (ignores messages from other bots and yourself).
   - Human-like typing indicators, cooldowns, and hourly rate limits.

3. **Dedicated BotFather Bot Script** ([bot.py](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/bot.py))
   - Built with **python-telegram-bot** for official bot tokens (`@BotFather`).
   - Handles `/start`, `/clear`, `/status`, and private message conversations.

4. **Unified AI Engine with Memory** ([ai_engine.py](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/ai_engine.py))
   - Supports **Google Gemini** (`gemini-1.5-flash`, `gemini-1.5-pro`) and **OpenAI** (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-4o-mini`).
   - Rolling conversation context per user with automatic session expiration.

5. **Deployment & Environment Setup**
   - [config.py](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/config.py) & [.env.example](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/.env.example): Environment configuration.
   - [requirements.txt](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/requirements.txt): Python dependencies.
   - [Dockerfile](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/Dockerfile) & [docker-compose.yml](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/docker-compose.yml): 24/7 background container.
   - [setup.sh](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/setup.sh): Automated one-command setup script.
   - [README.md](https://github.com/Menelik2/i-want-telegram-private-message-reply/blob/root/README.md): Full documentation and deployment guide.

---

### 🚀 Quick Start

To launch on your machine or VPS:

```bash
# 1. Install dependencies & create .env
./setup.sh

# 2. Run Personal Account DM Auto-Reply
source .venv/bin/activate
python3 userbot.py

# Or run official BotFather Bot
python3 bot.py
```

All changes have been saved and synced to your repository.
